messages.content:
You translate a traveller's one-day trip request in Singapore into a Python program that uses the z3
solver (`import z3`) to find a schedule satisfying EVERY requirement, or prove that none exists.

Facts (times in minutes since midnight, e.g. 09:00 = 540; money in whole SGD):
Places (id | name | cost | typical duration | open-close | showtimes):
clarke_quay | Clarke Quay | 30 | 90 | 17:00-24:00 | -
supertree_grove | Supertree Grove | 0 | 45 | 05:00-24:00 | -
east_coast_lagoon | East Coast Lagoon Food Village | 15 | 60 | 10:30-22:30 | -
orchard_road | Orchard Road | 0 | 120 | 10:00-22:00 | -
oceanarium | Singapore Oceanarium | 50 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -
botanic_gardens | Singapore Botanic Gardens | 0 | 120 | 05:00-24:00 | -
haw_par_villa | Haw Par Villa | 0 | 90 | 09:00-20:00 | -
lau_pa_sat | Lau Pa Sat | 15 | 60 | 00:00-24:00 | -
national_museum | National Museum of Singapore | 15 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -
Travel times in minutes between places (row -> column):
clarke_quay: supertree_grove 16, east_coast_lagoon 34, orchard_road 16, oceanarium 22, botanic_gardens 21, haw_par_villa 28, lau_pa_sat 13, national_museum 12
supertree_grove: clarke_quay 16, east_coast_lagoon 30, orchard_road 21, oceanarium 24, botanic_gardens 26, haw_par_villa 32, lau_pa_sat 14, national_museum 16
east_coast_lagoon: clarke_quay 34, supertree_grove 30, orchard_road 38, oceanarium 43, botanic_gardens 42, haw_par_villa 52, lau_pa_sat 34, national_museum 33
orchard_road: clarke_quay 16, supertree_grove 21, east_coast_lagoon 38, oceanarium 23, botanic_gardens 15, haw_par_villa 25, lau_pa_sat 18, national_museum 15
oceanarium: clarke_quay 22, supertree_grove 24, east_coast_lagoon 43, orchard_road 23, botanic_gardens 25, haw_par_villa 23, lau_pa_sat 20, national_museum 23
botanic_gardens: clarke_quay 21, supertree_grove 26, east_coast_lagoon 42, orchard_road 15, oceanarium 25, haw_par_villa 23, lau_pa_sat 23, national_museum 20
haw_par_villa: clarke_quay 28, supertree_grove 32, east_coast_lagoon 52, orchard_road 25, oceanarium 23, botanic_gardens 23, lau_pa_sat 29, national_museum 29
lau_pa_sat: clarke_quay 13, supertree_grove 14, east_coast_lagoon 34, orchard_road 18, oceanarium 20, botanic_gardens 23, haw_par_villa 29, national_museum 15
national_museum: clarke_quay 12, supertree_grove 16, east_coast_lagoon 33, orchard_road 15, oceanarium 23, botanic_gardens 20, haw_par_villa 29, lau_pa_sat 15

Rules of the domain: a visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical one unless the traveller gives one); it must
lie within opening hours; a show may only start at one of its showtimes; visits cannot overlap and consecutive
visits need the travel time between them; must-visit places are required, optional ones may be skipped;
budget is the sum of costs of visited places.

Contract: output ONE python code block. When run, the program must print exactly one final line:
either the word UNSAT, or a JSON list of objects {"location_id": id, "start": minutes, "end": minutes}
for the visited places. Do not read input, do not use the network, do not print anything after that line.

Example of the output format only: [{"location_id": "museum", "start": 540, "end": 660}]

My day out runs from 10:00 until 14:00. I can spend at most S$16. I want to visit Supertree Grove, Haw Par Villa and National Museum of Singapore. If there's time, I'd also like Clarke Quay, East Coast Lagoon Food Village, Orchard Road, Singapore Oceanarium, Singapore Botanic Gardens and Lau Pa Sat. I want to do National Museum of Singapore before Supertree Grove. I want to do Supertree Grove before National Museum of Singapore. I'd like to spend 30 minutes at East Coast Lagoon Food Village.
